node.title: how portable is the random number generator?
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
i tested a program under 5.42 and 5.38 and it worked the same on both versions. on how many computers would this program produce the expected output?

/usr/bin/perl -v This is perl 5, version 38, subversion 2 (v5.38.2) built for x86_64-linux-gnu-thread-multi /usr/bin/perl -E 'srand(80085);say(join("",map({g($_)}("3f5a64711350615c5b4f5867114c5666521f59535b604e57"=~m/../g))));sub g($num){chr(hex($num)+int(rand(31)));}' Just another Perl hacker perl -v This is perl 5, version 42, subversion 0 (v5.42.0) built for x86_64-linux perl -E 'srand(80085);say(join("",map({g($_)}("3f5a64711350615c5b4f5867114c5666521f59535b604e57"=~m/../g))));sub g($num){chr(hex($num)+int(rand(31)));}' Just another Perl hacker
